claim: On a team of four, conducted a severity-rated cognitive walkthrough of the Illinois Secretary of State DMV user flows.
detail: Evaluated dropdown selection, custom license plate entry, appointment confirmation saving, and service discovery actions.

claim: On a team of four, proposed information architecture and UI redesigns for the Illinois Secretary of State portal.
detail: Recommended explicit Standard (DL) and Commercial (CDL) labels, Health and Administrative Changes categories, consistent CTAs, and smaller banners.

claim: Critiqued remote moderated think-aloud testing and navigation feedback as a participant on an e-commerce gift site.
detail: Evaluated task realism, facilitator prompting, and missing error recovery and visual feedback during online purchase tasks.

claim: On a team of four, benchmarked Illinois Secretary of State website usability using SUS, UMUX, NPS, and satisfaction surveys.
detail: Collected post-test ratings from five participants across three tasks, recording an average SUS score of 61.

claim: On a team of four, analyzed survey and observational data from five Illinois residents to diagnose DMV navigation bottlenecks.
detail: Found 80% rated the site complicated and inconsistent, 60% felt expert help was needed, and hidden filters under Misc. blocked organ donor discovery.

claim: On a team of four, authored a summative usability test plan for the Illinois Secretary of State DMV website.
detail: Defined participant screening criteria, consent procedures, moderator script, three task scenarios with happy paths, and pre- and post-test questionnaires.

claim: On a team of four, ran five moderated Zoom usability sessions testing DMV appointment, organ donor, and license plate flows.
detail: Rotated moderator, evaluator, and two observer roles while logging task success, error, abandonment, and completion times.
